input.quote: Licensor hereby, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement, grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on our other businesses, so the preferred position (no non-compete on Customer) is met. The only Licensee-side restrictions are ordinary license-scope limits on use of the Licensor's own Licensed Technology (the "Field of Use" definition in 1.5 and the Additional Restrictions in Article II, including no sublicensing, no reverse engineering and no Derivative Works of the Licensed Technology); none of these prevents us from trading on, buying or building competing FX platforms, or from operating any line of business. Article X is a non-solicitation of Licensor employees only (no non-compete), and the license is expressly non-exclusive with no minimum-volume or exclusive-routing commitment. Noted but not flagged here: the change-of-control consent in Article XX (p0134) lets Licensor deem consent reasonably withheld where an acquirer competes with Licensor, which is an assignment/change-of-control point rather than a restrictive covenant on our operations and is addressed under the assignment rule.
